object.attr: derived: CF-S11, E12. Today a file whose size and modified time stay equal across a change isn't read again: a network share, a sync client or a copy that keeps times does that, and an edit made from the old text writes it back. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S4): tell a change by content.
object.description: If a file in a document's folder changed after Mellon last read the file, Mellon shall read the new content at the next read of the document, whatever the file's modified time and size.
